parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The task flow ID. You can call the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: DagInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the task flow instance. You can call the [ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: DagVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the task flow. You can call the [ListDAGVersions](~~424682~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
